core_obligations: Base field (proof lines 1698-1699): for the spectrum of the base field the assertion is exactly the axiom on the degree of the class of the base field.

Closed points (proof lines 1699-1716): for a closed point viewed as a morphism from the base field, the cycle class of the point is the pushforward of the class of the base field by compatibility of the cycle class map with pushforwards, so its degree is one by the definition of the pushforward on cohomology; since the base field is algebraically closed in the classical setting, the zero cycles are generated by such points.
proof_roadmap: Check the statement for the base field.
Express the class of a closed point by compatibility with pushforwards and compute its degree.
Use that closed points generate the group of zero cycles.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a classical Weil cohomology theory the degree of a zero cycle agrees with the cohomological degree of its cycle class (statement lines 1694-1705). The proof (proof lines 1706-1716) reduces to closed points, expresses their classes by compatibility with pushforwards, and computes the degree as one. H2: a short proof with a checkable substitution.
